title: Blocking the m 6 Am methyltransferase PCIF1 in macrophages attenuates colitis progression by preventing neuronal damage.
abstract: Macrophage-enteric neuron dialog is crucial for intestinal homeostasis, but its specific role and underlying mechanism in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) pathogenesis remain elusive. Here, we demonstrate that colonic macrophage-mediated extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling orchestrates enteric neuronal maturation and dictates colitis progression. The depletion of Pcif1, recognized as a unique methyltransferase for m 6 Am mRNA methylation, in macrophages attenuates colitis and protects enteric neurons from inflammation-driven degeneration. Specifically, Pcif1-deficient macrophages increase ECM accumulation, promoting their own extravasation into enteric neuronal plexuses and the maturation of enteric neurons, thereby curbing inflammation-driven neuronal injury and colitis progression. Mechanistically, Pcif1-mediated m 6 Am modification inhibits the translation of Znf219 mRNA and represses the Znf219-Egr1 axis, a master transcriptional module that governs ECM remodeling. Finally, pharmacological blockade of PCIF1 promotes macrophage-mediated ECM deposition and suppresses colitis and neuronal loss. Our findings reveal a novel mechanism whereby ECM remodeling in macrophages drives enteric neuronal maturation and illuminate the m 6 Am machinery as a promising therapeutic target for preventing neuronal loss in IBD patients.
authors: Ding C, Zhao J, Zhao T, Xiao Y, Li K, Liu X, Ge X, Qin D, Huang Z, Zhang Y, Liu H, Diao Z, Ye Y, Flavell RA, Luo C, Chen S, Yi C, Wang Z, Li HB.
screening_reason: The study directly investigates the crosstalk between colonic macrophages and enteric neurons during colitis and enteric neuronal degeneration.
summary_ja: 本研究は、潰瘍性大腸炎などの炎症性腸疾患の病態におけるマクロファージと腸管神経の相互作用メカニズムを解明した。マクロファージにおけるmRNAのm6Am修飾酵素PCIF1を欠損させると、細胞外基質（ECM）の蓄積が促進され、マクロファージの腸管神経叢への浸潤と腸管神経の成熟が誘導された。このプロセスにより、炎症に伴う神経変性と大腸炎の進行が抑制されることが明らかになった。機序としては、PCIF1によるm6Am修飾の抑制がZnf219-Egr1転写軸を活性化し、ECMリモデリングを駆動することが示された。
summary_en: This study demonstrates that colonic macrophage-mediated extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling regulates enteric neuronal maturation and colitis progression. Depleting or pharmacologically inhibiting the m6Am methyltransferase PCIF1 in macrophages promoted ECM accumulation, facilitating macrophage extravasation into enteric neuronal plexuses and protecting enteric neurons from inflammatory damage. This pathway operates via the Znf219-Egr1 transcriptional module, identifying PCIF1 as a promising target to preserve enteric neurons in inflammatory bowel disease.
key_finding_ja: マクロファージのPCIF1を阻害すると、細胞外基質のリモデリングを介して腸管神経の成熟と保護が促進され、大腸炎の進行が抑制された。
why_it_matters_ja: 腸管における免疫細胞と神経系の相互作用メカニズムが明示されたことで、炎症性腸疾患に伴う神経脱落を防止する新しい治療戦略の確立が期待される。

title: Endocannabinoids and related lipids in host metabolism-gut microbiome signalling.
abstract: Over the past two decades, it has become clear that the two endocannabinoids, anandamide and 2-arachidonoyl-glycerol, are only the tip of an iceberg of a larger signalling system composed of hundreds of chemically similar fatty acid derivatives, including 2-monoacylglycerols, N-acylethanolamines and other N-acylamines. Unlike the endocannabinoids, these lipids only seldom bind the two cannabinoid receptors, of which CB1 is now recognized as a major player in both the central and peripheral control of energy metabolism. They modulate instead the activity of other G-protein-coupled receptors, as well as of ligand-activated ion channels and nuclear receptors, which also regulate energy intake, accumulation and expenditure. Bacteria inhabiting the gut as part of the intestinal microbiome also produce endocannabinoid-like molecules capable of activating host receptors in vitro. These discoveries led to current research into potential bi-directional communication between this 'extended endocannabinoid system', or endocannabinoidome, and the gut microbiome. Ongoing studies are investigating how this axis might control energy metabolism, particularly in response to diet.
screening_reason: The article focuses directly on bidirectional signaling between the gut microbiome and host metabolism via endocannabinoids and related lipid signaling.
summary_ja: 本レビューは、エンドカンナビノイドおよびその類似脂質群（エンドカンナビノイドム）と腸内細菌叢との相互作用について論じている。これらの脂質メディエーターはカンナビノイド受容体やその他のGPCR、イオンチャネルなどを介してエネルギー代謝や摂食を調節する。腸内細菌もエンドカンナビノイド様分子を産生して宿主受容体を活性化することが分かっており、両者の双方向通信が注目されている。本稿では、食事応答やエネルギー代謝制御におけるこの拡大エンドカンナビノイドシステムと腸内細菌叢軸の役割を解説している。
summary_en: This review explores the bidirectional communication between the extended endocannabinoid system (endocannabinoidome) and the gut microbiome in regulating energy metabolism. In addition to classical endocannabinoids, numerous related lipid derivatives modulate host energy homeostasis through diverse receptors, while gut bacteria synthesize structurally similar lipids that activate these host pathways. The article highlights current insights into how this host-microbiome lipid signaling axis influences metabolic outcomes in response to diet.
key_finding_ja: 宿主のエンドカンナビノイドムと腸内細菌叢が産生する類似脂質との双方向シグナル伝達が、エネルギー代謝の制御に関与している。
why_it_matters_ja: 食事や腸内細菌叢に由来する脂質シグナルの解明が進むことで、代謝性疾患に対する新たな栄養的・薬学的介入アプローチの発見につながる可能性がある。

title: Human gut microbiome as a composite health biomarker.
abstract: Using a cohort of 893 adults who underwent medical check-ups with rich data collection across diet, lifestyle, clinical labs, cardiac stress testing, and microbiome profiling, we show that a gut microbial health index (MHI), originally defined using a large meta-analysis of various human disease cohorts, is also substantially associated with lifestyle and diet. This association persists across the overall cohort, disease-free subsets, and individuals with common medical conditions such as hypertension and dyslipidemia. The gut MHI was positively correlated with factors such as variation in cardiac stress test fitness, fiber intake, and well-being, and negatively correlated with exposure to ultra-processed foods and markers of subclinical inflammation (WBC and CRP mostly within normal limits). Lipidomics profiling of a subcohort revealed that triglycerides correlate positively with ultraprocessed foods, and negatively with unsaturated fats, olive oil, and nuts, linking diet, MHI, and lipid profile. Estimating the contribution of modifiable dietary and lifestyle factors to the MHI uncovers actionable ways to improve or worsen the personal MHI. Analyses of previously published intervention studies showed that the MHI responds quickly to dietary changes, within the predicted range. Our findings emphasize the potential of using microbiomes, and specifically the MHI, as a reporter of overall health.
authors: Braun T, Harounian O, Hadar R, Ziv A, Ben-Avraham Shulman S, Kalter-Leibovici O, Efroni G, Ziv R, Fenesh M, Abbas-Egbariya H, Abramovich I, Amit S, Keller N, Truman K, Segev S, Amir A, Haberman Y.
screening_reason: The research focuses on assessing the human gut microbiome and gut microbial health index in relation to dietary, metabolic, and clinical parameters.
summary_ja: 893名の成人コホートを対象に、腸内細菌叢健康指数（MHI）と生活習慣、食事、体力、炎症マーカーの関連が解析されました。その結果、MHIは食物繊維摂取量や体力と正の相関を示し、超加工食品の摂取や潜在的炎症マーカーと負の相関を示しました。さらに介入研究の解析から、MHIは食事の変更に対して迅速に反応することが確認されました。これらの結果は、腸内細菌叢が全身の健康状態を反映する複合的なバイオマーカーとして有効であることを示しています。
summary_en: In a cohort of 893 adults, the gut microbial health index (MHI) was significantly associated with diet, lifestyle, physical fitness, and markers of subclinical inflammation. Lipidomics and intervention analyses showed that MHI correlates with dietary habits and responds rapidly to dietary modifications. These findings highlight the potential of using the gut microbiome and MHI as a composite reporter of overall health.
key_finding_ja: 腸内細菌叢健康指数（MHI）は食事や運動、炎症状態と密接に関連し、食事介入に対して迅速に変化することが示されました。
why_it_matters_ja: MHIが全身の健康や生活習慣を反映する有用な指標として、個人の健康評価や食事指導に応用できる可能性があります。

title: EXPRESS: Spleen-mediated inflammation in ischemic stroke: mechanisms and targeted therapeutic strategies.
abstract: Stroke is a leading cause of death and disability worldwide. Emerging evidence from animal studies and clinical observations suggests that peripheral immune responses amplify neuroinflammation after acute ischemic stroke. This review briefly summarizes the interactions between peripheral immune responses and the ischemic brain, with a focus on the brain-spleen axis. Specifically, we dissect the mechanisms underlying spleen-mediated immune effects on the ischemic brain. We then critically summarize current spleen-targeted therapeutic strategies, ranging from physical and pharmacological interventions to stem cell-based approaches that reprogram splenic immune landscapes. Collectively, these insights aim to inform future immunomodulatory strategies targeting the brain-spleen axis.
authors: Wu S, Luo LH, Gao Y, Nan G.
journal: Journal of cerebral blood flow and metabolism : official journal of the International Society of Cerebral Blood Flow and Metabolism
screening_reason: The review centrally addresses peripheral immune-brain interactions and spleen-mediated neuroinflammation following acute ischemic stroke.
summary_ja: 本レビューは、虚血性脳卒中急性期後における脳と脾臓の相互作用軸（脳-脾臓軸）に焦点を当て、末梢免疫応答が脳内神経炎症を増幅するメカニズムを概括している。特に、脾臓が媒介する免疫効果と脳虚血病態への関与について整理している。さらに、物理的・薬理的介入や幹細胞を用いた脾臓の免疫環境再プログラミングなど、脾臓を標的とした最新の治療戦略を批判的にまとめている。これらの知見は、脳虚血に対する新たな免疫調節療法の開発に寄与することを目的としている。
summary_en: This review outlines the communication along the brain-spleen axis following acute ischemic stroke, emphasizing how peripheral immune responses driven by the spleen amplify central neuroinflammation. The authors detail the underlying cellular and molecular mechanisms of spleen-mediated post-stroke immune responses. Additionally, they evaluate emerging spleen-targeted therapeutic strategies, including physical, pharmacological, and stem cell-based interventions aimed at reprogramming the splenic immune landscape.
key_finding_ja: 虚血性脳卒中後において、脾臓を中心とする末梢免疫応答が脳の神経炎症を増幅させるメカニズムと、その治療標的としての可能性が提示された。
why_it_matters_ja: 脳-脾臓軸を介した末梢免疫制御システムへの介入は、脳卒中後の神経炎症軽減および脳損傷抑制のための新たな治療概念を提供する可能性がある。

title: Disease-specific tau polymorphs are associated with unique protein networks across proteinopathies.
abstract: Tau protein aggregates adopt distinct conformations across tauopathies, yet the protein interactions engaged by disease-specific polymorphs remain poorly characterized. Here, we demonstrate that conformationally distinct tau polymorphs associate with disease-specific interaction networks across Alzheimer's disease (AD), progressive supranuclear palsy (PSP), and dementia with Lewy bodies (DLB). Interactome profiling of tau aggregates from PBS- and sarkosyl-soluble brain fractions identified 493 high-confidence interactors exhibiting remarkable disease specificity. As an exploratory feature discovery machine learning classification discriminated against diseases using as few as four to six protein features. AD tau selectively engaged glycolytic enzymes, TCA cycle components, and glutamate/GABA cycling machinery, with the astrocytic transporter SLC1A2 showing 27-fold enrichment. PSP tau exhibited extensive interactor depletion alongside selective proteasome enrichment, whereas DLB tau associated with neurogenesis modulators while depleting neuroinflammatory mediators. Interaction patterns were corroborated by parallel reaction monitoring mass spectrometry and proximity ligation assays and corresponded to disease-specific post-translational modification profiles. These findings show that tau polymorph conformations are associated with disease-specific interaction networks, providing molecular insight into tauopathy heterogeneity.
authors: Puangmalai N, Bhatt N, Suthprasertporn N, Miranda-Morales EG, Shchankin N, Samples M, Balci AE, Liew JY, Montalbano M, Zhao Y, Kayed R.
screening_reason: The study investigates disease-specific tau protein interactomes linked to distinct post-translational modification profiles across proteinopathies.
summary_ja: アルツハイマー病（AD）、進行性核上性麻痺（PSP）、レビー小体型認知症（DLB）において、タウ蛋白の病態特異的な多形（ポリモルフ）が異なる相互作用ネットワークを形成していることが判明しました。相互作用解析により、病態特異性を持つ493個の高信頼性タンパク質相互作用因子が特定されました。ADタウは糖代謝酵素や神経伝達物質循環系と選択的に結合し、PSPタウはプロテアソームの濃縮、DLBタウは神経発生調節因子との関連を示しました。これらの相互作用パターンは、各疾患固有の翻訳後修飾プロファイルと一致していました。
summary_en: Tau aggregate polymorphs across Alzheimer's disease, progressive supranuclear palsy, and dementia with Lewy bodies associate with distinct protein interaction networks. Interactome profiling revealed 493 disease-specific interactor proteins that match unique post-translational modification profiles. These findings provide molecular insights into the pathobiological heterogeneity of tauopathies.
key_finding_ja: 疾患特異的なタウ蛋白多形が異なる相互作用ネットワークを形成し、特定の翻訳後修飾プロファイルに対応していることが明かとなりました。
why_it_matters_ja: タウオパチーの病態多様性の解明が進み、疾患に応じた個別化診断や治療標的の開発につながることが期待されます。

title: Low Dose Naltrexone in Depression: A Mechanistic Systematic Review of Convergent Neuroimmune Suppression and Endogenous Opioid Plasticity as a Mechanistic Framework
authors: Uppal G, Mohamed F, Gul N, Babu B, Pandian K.
screening_reason: The systematic review focuses on neuroimmune suppression and endogenous opioid plasticity as mechanistic frameworks in depression.
summary_ja: うつ病に対する低用量ナルトレキソンの治療機序に関するシステマティックレビューです。神経免疫抑制および内因性オピオイド系の可塑性を中心とした作用メカニズムの枠組みを提案しています。精神疾患治療における新たな薬理学的アプローチの可能性を論述しています。アブストラクトの本文情報は提供されていません。
summary_en: This systematic review evaluates the mechanistic framework of low-dose naltrexone in depression. It focuses on convergent neuroimmune suppression and endogenous opioid plasticity as therapeutic drivers. The review discusses potential pathways through which this pharmacotherapy exerts antidepressant effects.
key_finding_ja: 低用量ナルトレキソンのうつ病改善効果に神経免疫抑制とオピオイド可塑性が関与する統合的メカニズムが提示されました。
why_it_matters_ja: 神経免疫修飾を標的とした抗うつ治療の概念を深め、既存薬の再開発や病態に応じた創薬研究に貢献する可能性があります。

title: Biological Mechanisms of Psychotherapeutic Change: A Systematic Review of Neuroimmune, Autonomic and Epigenetic Changes Following CBT, Mindfulness Based and Trauma-Focused Therapies
authors: Gul N, Uppal G, Maryum M, Padiyan K, Babu B.
screening_reason: The systematic review's primary focus is on neuroimmune and autonomic biological mechanisms of psychotherapeutic change.
summary_ja: 認知行動療法（CBT）、マインドフルネス、トラウマ焦点型療法などの心理療法施行後における生物学的変化を評価したシステマティックレビューです。神経免疫系、自律神経系、およびエピジェネティクスにおける変動メカニズムについて考察されています。心理的介入が身体的・生理学的指標に及ぼす影響を包括的に整理しています。アブストラクトの本文情報は提供されていません。
summary_en: This systematic review synthesizes biological mechanisms of change following psychotherapies such as CBT, mindfulness, and trauma-focused therapies. It evaluates post-treatment shifts in neuroimmune, autonomic, and epigenetic markers. The review provides insight into how psychological interventions alter physiological systems.
key_finding_ja: 心理療法介入後における神経免疫系、自律神経系、エピジェネティクス変化の機序がシステマティックレビューとしてまとめられました。
why_it_matters_ja: 心理療法の生物学的基盤を裏付けることで、精神疾患に対する心身両面からの治療戦略の発展に寄与する可能性があります。

title: COVID-19 and the Forgotten Organ: Prolonged Changes to the Metabolic Output of the Gut Microbiome.
screening_reason: The study's primary topic concerns long-term metabolic output changes of the gut microbiome following COVID-19.
summary_ja: COVID-19感染後における腸内細菌叢の代謝出力および機能的変化に焦点を当てた論文です。感染が腸内微生物コミュニティの代謝機能に及ぼす持続的な影響について論じられています。腸内細菌叢が及ぼす全身性の代謝的役割が考察されています。アブストラクトの本文情報は提供されていません。
summary_en: This article examines prolonged alterations in the metabolic output of the gut microbiome following COVID-19 infection. It highlights the functional impact of viral infection on intestinal microbial metabolism over time. The piece discusses the role of the microbiome as a key factor in post-viral systemic changes.
key_finding_ja: COVID-19感染が腸内細菌叢の代謝出力に対して長期的な変化を引き起こす可能性が議論されています。
why_it_matters_ja: COVID-19後遺症における腸内代謝の関与を理解することで、微生物叢に着目した新たな回復促進策の検討に繋がる可能性があります。

title: Correction: circ_0044235 exacerbates neuroinflammation and apoptosis following spinal cord injury by targeting miR-338-5p.
authors: Lin M, Huang L, Zhang B, Wang Y, Zhu X, Zeng W.
journal: Journal of orthopaedic surgery and research
screening_reason: This erratum notice pertains directly to a primary study examining circ_0044235 in regulating neuroinflammation following spinal cord injury.
summary_ja: 本論文は、脊髄損傷後の神経炎症とアポトーシスにおけるcirc_0044235とmiR-338-5pの役割を扱った既報論文に対する訂正（Correction）記事である。提供された抄録本文には特定のデータや結果の記述は含まれていない。研究の正確な内容や修正箇所については元の原著論文を参照する必要がある。
summary_en: This is a correction notice for a previously published study concerning the role of circ_0044235 and miR-338-5p in neuroinflammation and apoptosis following spinal cord injury. No abstract text or specific study data are provided in this notice. Readers should consult the original publication for detailed methodological and experimental findings.
key_finding_ja: 本文献は脊髄損傷後の神経炎症に関連する論文の訂正通知である。
why_it_matters_ja: 学術論文の正確性を担保し誤解を防ぐために訂正情報の確認は重要である。
